estimate.damage_summary: During a swerve on a drive in Germany, the laptop was thrown against the car door, cracking the screen and damaging the lower-right housing corner. The screen assembly and damaged housing shell were replaced; the lid scuff was pre-existing.
estimate.policy_notes: The described impact is sudden external action, including displacement by a conveyance manoeuvre (2.6.1–2.6.2), and portable equipment is covered temporarily away from the insured location within Germany (4.5.2). Necessary repair work and corresponding replacement components are indemnifiable subject to the pre-loss standard (7.1.7, 7.1.9–7.1.10); necessary diagnostic examination is covered under 5.2.3, capped at EUR 250 including VAT per event. Polishing the pre-existing scuff is not covered (7.1.5, 7.1.8(a), 7.1.11).

lines.rationale: The screen cracked in the reported impact, and necessary repair or replacement of the affected display assembly is covered under 2.6.3 and 7.1.7(c), subject to the pre-loss standard in 7.1.9 and the repair basis in 7.1.10. One display repair is plausible; the upper-end reasonable net allowance reflects a standard equivalent assembly and fitting, with the description indicating that this was the larger share of the repair bill.

The reported impact damaged the lower-right corner, and replacement of the affected housing shell is a plausible necessary repair under 2.6.3 and 7.1.7(c), limited to the pre-loss specification by 7.1.9–7.1.10. One housing repair is justified; the reasonable net amount allows for a standard replacement shell and fitting, while the description indicates this was the smaller share of the repair bill.

lines.invoice_text: Polish of pre-existing lid scuff (surface only, does not affect operation)
lines.rationale: The polish concerns a pre-existing cosmetic scuff, not damage caused by the reported impact, so it is outside the affected parts under 7.1.5 and is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.11. The quantity is plausible as an optional polish, but the line has no indemnifiable value; the stated unit price is estimated only on the assumption that the line were valid.

The shop’s examination to establish the damage and repair scope is covered as an examination cost under 5.2.3, provided the 2.6 insured-event gateway is met; the per-event limit is EUR 250 including VAT. One initial inspection is plausible and the reasonable amount is modest for a short diagnostic slot; no further transport or duplicate charge is stated.
